76950.body:
Today’s newsletter is brought to you by **[Choose Rich Live](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**[!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)

Our very own Nick O’Neill is has launched a new stream covering crypto, finance, AI, tech, and the stories shaping the internet economy.

If you already follow Nick, you know what to expect: sharp takes, market chaos, founder brain, and the occasional banger you’ll see clipped on the timeline five minutes later.

Episodes will be streaming live on YouTube, so make sure you’re subscribed to catch the next one as it happens.

**[Subscribe to Choose Rich Live!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**

———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $63,866 (1.6%) | **ETH** $1,872 (0.9%) | **SOL** $74 (1.3%)

* S&P closes just $20 below [previous ATH](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2084348150131634558?s=20) as a [new peace deal](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2084608853056885137?s=20) with Iran is on the horizon

* Iran denies US claim that Hormuz is [completely controlled](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2084301119308865943?s=20) by the US

* [PLTR surges 8%](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2084370989249388936?s=20) after earnings beat and revised forward guidance

* FBI agent is accused of [stealing $1M](https://www.theblock.co/post/410491/fbi-agent-stealing-1-million-crypto-turned-to-chatgpt-vacation-plans) worth of crypto from adversaries

* Russia [bans crypto mining](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2083635836633903257?s=20) in Moscow until 2032

* [Senate schedule](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2084098458495942780?s=20) fails to include Clarity Act

* Coldcard hack losses now [top $100M](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2084413716494266594?s=20)

* Telegram is briefly [removed](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2084448699514753341?s=20) from the Apple App Store — fomo enters the [top 10](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2084343002571661600?s=20) US finance apps

* Pump Fun records [highest weekly revenue](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2084330982400749615?s=20) since March — PUMP has [gained 44%](https://x.com/Tyler_Did_It/status/2084601115052535948?s=20) in the last month

* POAP protocol [winds down](https://x.com/izonline/status/2084273977938080092?s=20)

* Amazon surpasses a [$3T market cap](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2084275317955531052?s=20) for the first time

* CASHCAT takes back number 1 meme position on [Robinhood Chain](https://x.com/Tyler_Did_It/status/2084607449781145664?s=20)

* Franklin Templeton joins the Canton network as a [super validator](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2084351433651191924?s=20)

* Rekt x Faze [energy drink cans](https://x.com/rektdrinks/status/2083923299914953008?s=20) are now available on Amazon

* [1/1 Moonbird card](https://x.com/moonbirds/status/2084353446866735441?s=20) sells for $25K on OpenSea

———————————————————————————


———

but the broader trend remains rangebound ahead of the Senate's
August recess deadline on August 7.

That deadline is now the market's most urgent policy watch. A
bill that could reshape US crypto regulation has just days left
before it stalls until September. Meanwhile institutional
treasury moves are pulling in opposite directions.

Let's dive in.

Latest News

The Crypto Bill Has Days Left Before Senate Recess

Bernstein warned on August 3 that the CLARITY Act faces its
final window before the Senate recesses around August 7, with
Polymarket pricing year-end passage at just 31%. A failure would
likely trigger a short-term market sell-off.

Analysts expect the SEC and CFTC to accelerate rulemaking
through their joint Project Crypto initiative if the bill does
not pass.

76944.subject: OpenAI fires back at Apple’s trade secret lawsuit, but the evidence cuts both ways ⚔️⚖️; Coinbase’s Q2 2026: a rec…
76944.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1108

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Tuesday! Today, we’re diving into the Apple vs OpenAI trade secret war, which just escalated big time with OpenAI publishing internal iMessages & emails to publicly fight Apple's lawsuit (what it’s all about & how OpenAI's public defense may have accidentally handed Apple more ammunition + bonus dives into OpenAI’s IPO plans [ https://substack.com/redirect/9e4fbe6e-fee0-4f10-a427-6a33703812ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], their Super App strategy [ https://substack.com/redirect/f6456381-da98-4297-a718-793e43088c5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & How to Build Loops at Scale [ https://substack.com/redirect/5a323dd3-a897-4375-9ead-ae20533312b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and diving deep into Coinbase's latest financials to see why the market share it fought so hard to win just stopped paying (breaking down the most important facts & figures from Coinbase's Q2 2026 to see whether $COIN  is still worth your time & money + bonus deep dive into Robinhood’s latest financials [ https://substack.com/redirect/ea19029f-1c28-4479-937c-b9452a72dc0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], & How to Turn Claude Opus 5 Into a Financial Analyst That Never Sleeps [ https://substack.com/redirect/4a4ee4c0-a92e-40c1-9483-119f9c50ba68?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside).
